title: approvals: GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/UNKNOWN/actions answers 200 [] while GET /requests/UNKNOWN answers 404
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8). It belongs to the "unknown id answers empty instead of 404" class that #25486 fixed for other doors.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase and sign in as admin.
2. `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/areq_does-not-exist` returns 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.
3. `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/areq_does-not-exist/actions` returns 200 `{"data":[]}`.
4. Expected: the actions sub-resource answers 404 for a request that does not exist (or is not visible to the caller), the same as its parent. A non-participant reading an existing request's actions should get the same answer as the parent read.
5. Actual: 200 with an empty list. "No actions yet" cannot be told apart from "no such request". A non-participant also gets 200 `[]` on a real request's `/actions`, which leaks no rows but answers differently from the parent's 404.

## Mechanism
`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts` ~L574–590 returns `{data: rows}` from `svc.listActions` without first resolving the request under the caller's scope.
